Basics

Sweet potato base

Édesburgonyás lap

7 months+ Sound idea 45 min 6 portions

From 7 months, under a spread the child already tolerates. For a first egg, use a plain cooked egg on its own before hiding egg in this bake.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 medium sweet potato (baked until soft)
  • 40 g ground oats (listed as gluten)
  • 1 egg (baked until fully set)
  • 1 tbsp rapeseed or olive oil (keeps the sheet soft)

Allergens

egggluten

Method

  1. Bake the sweet potato until soft, then scoop out the flesh.
  2. Mash it with the ground oats, egg, and oil.
  3. Press the mix thinly on a lined tray.
  4. Bake at 180 C until the egg is fully set and the centre stays soft.
  5. Cool and cut pieces to use under spreads.
  6. If the edges turn crisp, offer the soft middle only.

Sound idea

An undercooked egg or a hard crisp base would undo a useful idea.

Press baked sweet potato, ground oats, egg, and oil into a thin sheet and bake it until the egg is fully cooked and the centre stays soft. Use the sheet as a base for spreads.
